description:
Build settings of a project: read them, or change them without the
    dashboard — the way out when detection guessed wrong (wrong folder,
    wrong type, wrong command).

    `get` returns `settings` (what is saved on the project; null — not set,
    the platform decides), `resolved` (what the next build will actually use,
    per field: `value`, `source`, `policy`) and `last_build` (what the latest
    ready build was really built with). Precedence is `layero.json` in the
    repository > project settings > detection > framework default: a field
    with `policy: "locked_by_file"` is set by `layero.json`, and changing the
    project setting will not change the build — edit the file instead.

    `update` CHANGES HOW THE PROJECT IS BUILT — ask the person first unless
    they asked for exactly this change. Prefer `layero.json` in the repository
    for anything that should live with the code; use this tool for what the
    file cannot hold (`root_directory`, `project_type`) and for projects you
    cannot push to. Nothing is rebuilt by the update itself: apply it with
    `retry_deploy(redeploy=true)` or a push.

action.description: `get` — show the build settings and what they resolve to. `update` — change the settings passed in the other arguments; arguments you omit stay as they are.
action.title: Action

force_type.description: Set `project_type` even though the platform detected another type.
force_type.title: Force Type

framework.description: Framework preset for a static build: `vite`, `nextjs`, `astro`, `generic`, `static` …
framework.title: Framework

install_command.description: Install command. `""` resets to auto-detection by lockfile.
install_command.title: Install Command

node_version.description: Node major, e.g. `22`. `""` resets to auto-detection.
node_version.title: Node Version

output_directory.description: Folder that holds `index.html` AFTER the build (`dist`, `build`, `dist/client`).
output_directory.title: Output Directory

port.description: Container apps: the port the app listens on. `0` resets to the default.
port.title: Port

project.description: The project: its slug (`my-site`) or id, as listed by `my_projects`. The site address works too (`https://clear-garden-vypm.layero.app` or just `clear-garden-vypm`) — note that the address host is NOT always the slug.
project.title: Project

project_type.description: How the project runs: `spa` — static files (any static framework); the others — an app in a container. The platform checks the repository and may object (409): then re-read the objection and pass `force_type=true` only if the person insists.
project_type.title: Project Type

root_directory.description: App folder inside the repository (`apps/web`). `""` resets to the repository root. Changing it clears the detected framework and commands of the old folder.
root_directory.title: Root Directory

start_command.description: Container apps: start command, listening on `0.0.0.0` and `$PORT`. `""` resets to detection by entry point.
start_command.title: Start Command

name: project_settings
title: Настройки сборки проекта
